registers.ESP: DIR3 and the Registro de Entidades Locales

fields.u: the government's own website, as the register publishes it
fields.e: public email addresses, every one the register holds
fields.c: certified email (Italy's PEC): refuses mail from an ordinary account
fields.a: street address as printed, with the place's name added at render time
fields.j: how the row was joined, where it was not a shared code
fields.src: which register the record came from

note: Keyed by Wikidata id. shard = int(qid[1:]) % 512. A record states what its register publishes; nothing here is derived from a name or a pattern.
